Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ooh, you know, kids, this theater was built over 70 years ago in this Neo-Egyptian style. And apparently, there used to be a pharaoh's tomb display with a mummy in a sarcophagus. I mean, you couldn't pick a better place to watch a classic, old mummy movie.

Name: Explorer
Dialog: (In movie) There's an inscription here. An...an incantation of some sort. "Owah Tagu Siam!"

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Dad, where do you find a mummy?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hidden deep in the bowels of the pyramids. (Phone rings) Whoops, better put this on vibrate.

Name: Explorer
Dialog: (In movie) The incantation will make the mummy come to life and obey your commands. Well, beat me with a chicken. (The mummy starts beating him with a chicken) Ow! What?! Ooh! Hey! Stop! It's an--ow! Hey!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! Dad, is it hard to get into a pyramid?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Yes, indeed. Often you had to negotiate many booby traps that were set centuries before.

Name: Explorer
Dialog: (In movie) You ridiculous mummy. You just tripped one of your own booby traps. (There is a rumbling noise, and rocks begin to fall on the explorer and the mummy) She's gonna blow! (They run for the exit, barely getting out in time)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Awesome booby trap! (at Ferb) Ferb, we should get our own mummy.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That would be awesome! (At Lawrence) Dad, can we--

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (Snoring)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, Ferb. We'll be back before he wakes up.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, those bozos aren't pulling anything on my watch! (Grunts)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. Where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. Doofenshmirtz is at it again. It appears that he's purchased a string of odd items

Name: Computer voice
Dialog: Dive. Dive. Dive.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mr. Employee, sir, where's the mummy exhibit?

Name: Employee
Dialog: (Presses button) Manager assistance requested.

Name: Employee #2
Dialog: Yes?

Name: Employee
Dialog: These boys want to know where the mummy exhibit is.

Name: Employee #2
Dialog: It's in storage. In the basement.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Guess who's goin' to the basement!

Name: Woman
Dialog: Uh, excuse me, where are the restrooms?

Name: Employee
Dialog: Manager assistance requested.

Name: Employee #2
Dialog: Yes?

Name: Candace
Dialog: There they go.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Look! Pith helmets! We might be going the right way. Say something pithy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's it. I'm calling Dad.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (Laughs) Ohh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, forget it! I'm going in myself.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Did you hear that? Maybe it's the mummy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Screams) Eww. My shoe is all squishy!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, Ferb? What are you doing? Woah! Who know looking for mummies would be so much fun? Watch this! (Thud) Ugh!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb, this was our first booby trap! Woo! Hey, look! The storage! We're here!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh-oh-oh-oh-oh, when I catch them... (Ball rolling) (Screams)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, give me a break!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bubble gum? Oh, really old, stale bubble gum! Blaugh! Phineas!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Almost done, just this one more little bit!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus! As usual, your timing is incredible! And by "Incredible", of course I mean

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Owah Tagu Siam! (Air hissing) There's nothing here but fakey promotional lobby junk. For all we know, there might not be such thing as a mummy. (At Mummy Candace) Yeah, I'll be right with you. I mean-- (Gasps)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Screams; Slams door)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, I didn't expect them to be so scary. I mean, can you imagine the angry, twisted soul hidden under those bandages?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Makes me shudder. But you know what? We came down here looking for a mummy, and I'm not leaving without one. Let's get him!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. We got our own mummy! Now, how are we going to get it home?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And...finished! (Button beep)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It is working! (Laughs) It is functioning properly!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Gasps) Perry the Platypus? You defeated my bubble of pure evil? Ooh! (Lasers firing; Water flooding) Oh, no! What? (Bubble pops) Is my nose really that pointy? (Screaming and grunting)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know what this is? Our second booby trap! (Water splashing) There you are, Perry.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: WOO-HOO-HOO! OH YEAH! WOO-HOO! OH YEAH! (at Candace) Hey, Candace, you missed all the fun. Allow me to introduce our mummy. (realizes the "mummy" isn't there) Hey, where's our mummy? Mummy? Mummy?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, Mummy has supper waiting for us at home. (At Candace) Candace, why are you all wet?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Growls)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: You know, mummies had their brains pulled out through their nose.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Scoffs) The lucky ones.
